subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Disobediaent**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Disobediaent" is correctly spelt as ***Disobedient***.
 
• Disobedient means ***refusing*** to follow through with orders.
 
• ***Example:***
 
 
• He is a disobedient boy. ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information​__**

 
• ***Disapprove*** means to believe someone or something to be bad, dumb, etc.
 
• ***Proportionate*** means in equal proportion.
 
• ***Overreact*** means to react excessively, especially in response to something unpleasant.
